title: Jelly like Italian Samphire Pasta
description: Indulgent Neapolitan dish featuring samphire, dashi extract, and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients, resulting in a fatty and glassy jelly like texture.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the samphire to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dashi extract and lemon juice.
Add the grated grana padano cheese to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Add the unsalted butter to the bowl and whisk until fully incorporated.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the samphire and garlic.
Pour the cheese and dashi mixture over the pasta and toss to combine.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional grated cheese if desired.
